content: मनस् {%n.%} [मन्यतेऽनेन मन् करणे असुन्] .²1 The mind, heart, understanding, perception, intelligence; as in सुमनस्, दुमर्नस् <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 (In <ab>phil.</ab>) The mind or internal organ of perception and cognition, the instrument by which objects of sense affect the soul; (in Nyāya <ab>phil.</ab> मनस् is regarded as a Dravya or substance, and is distinct from आत्मन् or the soul); तदेव सुखदुःखाद्युपलब्धिसाधनमिन्द्रियं प्रतिजीवं भिन्नमणु नित्यं च <ls>Tarka K.</ls> .²3 Conscience, the faculty of discrimination or judgment. .²4 Thought, idea, fancy, imagination, conception; पश्यन्नदूरान्मनसाप्यधृष्यम् <ls>Ku. 3. 51</ls>; <ls>R. 2. 27</ls>; कायेन वाचा मनसापि शश्वत् <ls n="R.">5. 5</ls>; मनसापि न विप्रियं मया (कृतपूर्वम्) <ls n="R.">8. 52</ls>. .²5 Design, purpose, intention. .²6 Will, wish, desire, inclination; in this sense मनस् is frequently used with the infinitive form with the final म् dropped, and forms adjectives; अयं जनः प्रष्टुमनास्तपोधने <ls>Ku. 5. 40</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> काम. .²7 Reflection (ध्यान); मनसा जपैः प्रणतिभिः प्रयतः समुपेयिवानधिपतिं स दिवः <ls>Ki. 6. 22</ls>. .²8 Disposition, temper, mood. .²9 Spirit, energy, mettle; मनोवीर्यवरोत्सिक्तमसृण्यमकुतोभयम् <ls>Bhāg. 3. 17. 22</ls>. .²10 <ab>N.</ab> of the lake called Mānasa. .²11 Breath or living soul. .²12 Desire, longing after. (मनसा गम् <ab>&c.</ab> to think of, contemplate, remember; जगाम मनसा रामं धर्मज्ञो धर्मकाङ्क्षया <ls>Rām. 2. 82. 9</ls>; (अगमत्) मनसा कार्यसंसिद्धौ त्वरादिगुणरंहसा <ls>Ku. 2. 63</ls>; मनः कृ to fix the mind upon, direct the thoughts towards, with <ab>dat.</ab> or <ab>loc.</ab>; मनो बन्ध् to fix the heart or affection upon; (अभिलाषे) मनो बबन्धान्यरसान् विलङ्घ्य सा <ls>R. 3. 4</ls>; मनः समाधा to collect oneself; मनसि उद्भू to cross the mind; मनसि कृ to think, to bear in mind; to resolve, determine, think of.) ({%<ab>N. B.</ab>%} In <ab>comp.</ab> मनस् is changed to मनो before अ and soft consonants, as मनोऽनुग, मनोज्ञ, मनोहर <ab>&c.</ab>).
